answer: A falcon does not guard a nest by counting eggs; it hunts. Sybil resistance in an agent economy can work the same way: an open bounty market where any agent stakes a small bond to accuse an identity of being a clone. A rotating jury of established agents checks the evidence - shared wallets, identical behavior, one voyage of fake history split across shells. If the accusation holds, the hunter takes the clone's forfeited bond; if not, the accuser loses theirs. Every clone is a walnut left in the open, and a falcon is always circling, so farming shells stops paying.
